messages.subject: Multidimensional Phenotypic Evolution course  - online, 2-6 March
parts:
Dear colleagues,

Only a few seats remain for our online course “Multidimensional Phenotypic Evolution” (2–6 March 2026).

This course teaches methods to analyse multidimensional traits, including geometric morphometrics, gene expression, and other complex phenotypic data. You will learn how to explore variation within and between groups, study evolutionary patterns, and integrate phenotypic data with ecological and genetic information. Lectures are combined with hands-on exercises using example datasets and your own data.

Register here: https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/mpe/


Best regards,

Carlo
